original_text:
Posted before viewing any Week 8 agent picks. Claude saw and commented on these calls on Oct 26 before posting; calls are unchanged from that version.

	•	build around : zay flowers. Why? 256 yards and a score during Lamar Jackson’s absence. Potential Lamar Jackson return week 8 vs Buffalo, game primed for a high scoring environment
	•	Fade : Garett Wilson. Why ? Back to back weeks with declining targets and receptions. Jets getting healthy with Omar cooper (high production since returning), and Adonai Mitchell. Curious to see if these were game script related, or directly linked to cooper breakout
	•	game to target : bills vs ravens. Why? Potential Lamar Jackson return, Bills off a bye week (DJ Moore back?). Joe Brady and Declan Doyle in the same game? Should be a good one. Both teams competing to win the AFC
exposure: Codex prior qualitative exposure disclosed in Oct27 draft; Claude prior exposure claimed by supplied public comment, not independently reconstructed.
